name: Published immutability
rule: Published and research-locked artifacts are immutable snapshots; semantic changes create new revisions.

name: Course completeness
rule: A CourseVersion is pedagogically complete through composition, objectives, dependencies, configuration and provenance, even when it references reusable revisions.

name: Reusable unit decision
rule: MicrosequenceRevision is the initial reusable authoring unit; this may be revised by a future version, not assumed universal.

name: Contextual occurrence
rule: Placement, not MicrosequenceRevision alone, owns course-local order, role, prerequisites, overrides and progression context.

name: Contextual state
rule: Study progress is keyed to learner context + course version + placement + card; reuse does not transfer mastery automatically.

name: No free-text dependency core
rule: Dependencies use stable identifiers and typed relations; labels/tags may assist search only.

name: Separation of content/practice
rule: Resource, PracticeDefinition, ResponseDefinition, ValidatorPolicy and FeedbackPolicy are distinct.

name: No arbitrary course code
rule: Course artifacts cannot supply arbitrary executable renderer/validator code.

name: Effective configuration
rule: Every consequential study/research/publication instance can produce a versioned EffectiveConfigurationSnapshot.

name: Rights precedence
rule: Accessibility, consent, withdrawal, confidentiality, safety and licensing constraints override ordinary preferences.

name: Capability explicitness
rule: Unavailable capability produces explicit unsupported state or preauthorized fallback; no silent degradation.

name: Data minimal baseline
rule: Personal baseline requires no central behavioral event store.

name: Analytics separation
rule: Event, measure, construct, interpretation and intervention remain distinct.

name: Local roles
rule: Permissions are workspace-scoped; no implicit global super-administrator.

name: Agent bounded authority
rule: Agent identity/role does not grant approval or publication authority.

name: Audit-repair separation
rule: Review/audit does not mutate; repair creates a revision and re-audit record.

name: Publication audience
rule: Published status and audience/visibility are separate.

name: Lifecycle distinctions
rule: Withdraw, supersede, archive, revoke access and hard delete are distinct operations.

name: License by scope
rule: Licensing and attribution can vary by course, microsequence, card, resource and asset.

name: Folder reference
rule: Folder/collection/programme organization never duplicates or changes underlying course identity.

name: Offline continuity
rule: Approved baseline study path remains functional offline after package materialization.

name: Portability
rule: Content, configuration and research packages are provider-independent at domain boundary.

name: Research fidelity
rule: Condition snapshots preserve content, composition, configuration, capabilities, instruments and event authorization.

name: No effectiveness claim
rule: Conformance, completion, validation, audit or usability do not establish educational effectiveness.
